title: Incorrect linking of `manifest` if `basePath` is provided.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/jovial-hill-xjznkk?file=%2Fapp%2Fpage.tsx%3A5%2C54

### To Reproduce

1. Start the application in dev.
2. Navigate to root of application with `basePath` (here, `/sample-base`)
3. Open developer console:
![image](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/20752081/517011c0-f052-4c8b-a70c-204a266c2b53)

### Current vs. Expected behavior

Manifest described in `app` directory is incorrectly linked in `head` of html page.
![image](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/20752081/97425f3c-d03d-4877-84d0-f874200ed0f7)
Expected for manifest to be correctly linked with `basePath` prefix.

### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
  Platform: linux
  Arch: x64
  Version: #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sun Aug  6 20:05:33 UTC 2023
Binaries:
  Node: 16.17.0
  npm: 8.15.0
  Yarn: 1.22.19
  pnpm: 7.1.0
Relevant Packages:
  next: 13.5.5-canary.5
  eslint-config-next: N/A
  react: 18.2.0
  react-dom: 18.2.0
  typescript: 5.1.3
Next.js Config:
  output: N/A
```


### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

Not sure, App Router, Metadata (metadata, generateMetadata, next/head)

### Additional context

_No response_
